_about: Shared place table for World Patch Notes.
places: key -> lat, lon, label, kind (country | territory | region | state | place).
country: for sub-places, the country key they roll up to (used for per-country counts).
ne: the country's name in the world-atlas countries-110m outline file.
rules: keyword patterns (JS regex source, wrapped in \b(...)\b) used by scripts/geotag.js
to suggest places for an entry from its text. Order matters: most specific first.
Each change in data/weeks/*.json carries "places": [keys...], primary place first; [] means global.
